items.quote: Überweisen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag bitte spätestens 21 Tage nach dem Datum dieser Rechnung.
items.computation: Invoice date (the triggering event) is 21.11.2026 (a Saturday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, since the period begins with an event, the day of the event itself is not counted, so day 1 of the 21-day period is 22.11.2026. Counting 21 days forward: 22.11. + 20 more days = 12.12.2026, which is day 21. 12.12.2026 falls on a Saturday (24.11.2026 is a Tuesday, and 12.12. is 18 days later; 18 mod 7 = 4, Tuesday+4 = Saturday). Under § 193 BGB, if the last day of a period for performance (including payment) falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period ends on the next business day instead. 13.12.2026 is a Sunday, so the next business day is Monday 14.12.2026, which is not a public holiday in Nordrhein-Westfalen. Therefore the payment is due by 14.12.2026.
